title: Legal contract lifecycle bundle
description: Agreement and statement-of-work evidence for governed contract review.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: legal-contract-lifecycle
  title: Legal contract lifecycle bundle
  description: Agreement and statement-of-work evidence for governed contract review.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-legal-01
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/legal
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs: [agreement.agreement_type, agreement.effective_date, agreement.governing_law, statement_of_work.sow_number, statement_of_work.total_contract_value]
      relationshipIds: [has_party, contains, governed_by]
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/legal/nda_msa, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/legal/sow, role: supporting }
